create.name: Elizabeth Pyjov
create.bio:
Elizabeth Pyjov is a meditation teacher, poet and lawyer who founded Happiness Sangha, an online community that teaches self-compassion and contentment through Buddhist practice, contemplative ritual and the psychology of wellbeing. She studied Romance languages at Harvard College, completed Stanford's programme on the science and teaching of compassion, and later earned both a law degree and a master's in Buddhist studies at Harvard. She has learned from Thich Nhat Hanh, the Dalai Lama and Jon Kabat-Zinn, and teaches on the faculty of Loyola University Chicago's business and law schools.

Most of her teaching happens live on Zoom: themed classes on compassion, gratitude, the inner critic, relationships and honouring one's ancestors, many of which can later be bought as recordings, along with seasonal rituals and a free Thanksgiving morning meditation she has led for several years. She also runs residential retreats on the Italian island of Ischia, including programmes for judges and senior lawyers, and works with companies and courts on compassionate leadership. Her poetry collection Divinity School reads Christian figures and stories through a Buddhist eye, and her talks and conversations appear on her YouTube channel and her podcast, Give and Receive.

courses.title: Beauty of Imperfection, Kindness to Imperfection
courses.description: A recorded talk and meditation on why Buddhist thought treats imperfection as part of the path rather than something to fix. Bought once and watched at your own pace.

courses.title: Compassion to Past Versions of Ourselves
courses.description: A workshop in which participants direct compassion towards themselves at earlier stages of life. Elizabeth guides the practice and talks about why kindness to our past selves matters.

courses.title: Algorithm for a Loving Romantic Relationship: Practices for Happy & Healthy Love
courses.description: A recorded class for single people and couples alike, looking at love as a place of inner growth. Elizabeth sets out meditations and reflections to prepare for, or deepen, a partnership.

courses.title: Lawyer Leadership Summit (Ischia, Italy)
courses.description: A five-day residential gathering in Ischia for attorneys who lead teams, built around self-awareness, empathy and compassion as leadership skills. Meditation and reflection run alongside the sessions.

courses.title: VIP Day with Elizabeth Pyjov
courses.description: A private eight-hour day with Elizabeth in New York City, combining one-to-one practice, conversation and time in the city. Booked by enquiry.

free_resources.title: Elizabeth Pyjov on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her Insight Timer profile, with guided meditations on compassion, gratitude and kindness towards oneself. The tracks are free to play.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditations from Happiness Sangha
free_resources.description: A page of short guided practices led by Elizabeth, from a heart-centring practice to gratitude and self-forgiveness, plus seasonal rituals through the year. Free to play on the site.

free_resources.title: Give and Receive (podcast)
free_resources.description: Elizabeth's free podcast of conversations about generosity, purpose and contentment, with guests from law, business and the arts.

flags: No base published on her own site; the queue said New York, which fits the VIP Day and a past NYC daylong, but her bio also lists current Loyola University Chicago faculty posts. Left as no_public_base; she may confirm.

Her site carries some health framing: the year-long 'Journey to Happiness' ($6,500) page says it has helped people stop panic attacks and come off antidepressants, and the Meditate page summarises studies on pain and anxiety. Those items are left out; the remaining classes are about compassion, imperfection and relationships.

Her YouTube channel mixes teaching with business, AI and interview episodes; only her own teaching talks were chosen. Two titles use 'heal' in a general sense (How Women Heal; Ancestors ... Healing), kept as they name no condition: a human may prefer to drop them.
VIP Day is priced at $50,000 USD as published on her Offerings page.
Her poetry book Divinity School has no ISBN on her site and no Open Library record, so it is mentioned in the bio but not listed as a book.
Lawyer Leadership Summit is a Happiness Sangha programme in Ischia, Italy; price not shown.
left_out: Journey to Happiness ($6,500): sales page claims it helps stop panic attacks and come off antidepressants (health rule).
Becoming Self-Compassionate programme: lists less anxiety, less depression, better sleep and a stronger immune system as benefits (health rule).
Freedom from the Inner Critic: blurb is aimed at people who are anxious (health rule, borderline).
Freedom That Starts With You (17–22 Nov 2026): page promises to transform pain and anxiety (health rule).
Woman's Strength and Ancestors Retreat (6–8 Nov 2026): starts before 7 Nov 2026.
Weekend and 5-day retreats and the $1,500 one-off session: link only to Stripe checkouts, no page of their own.
Divinity School (book): no ISBN confirmed on Open Library.
YouTube: narcissism/gaslighting, news anxiety, AI and business interview videos, Shorts and testimonials not used.
